workflow.title: Simple clicks. Drive Growth in Google and AI Models

step1.title: Enter Your Keyword
step1.description: Simply enter the keyword and choose your target market region and language, Nexaura AI will automatically anaylze the keyword's user search intent.

step2.title: Choose Your Article Topic
step2.description: After analyze the user search intent, Nexaura AI will provide a few article topics that cover all user search intents of the keyword you want to raise ranking.

step3.title: Choose Your Article Titile
step3.description: Nexaura AI will conduct a deepsearch on relevant content to ensure the article's quality. Then brainstorm and provide you with several high-click-rate title options.

step4.title: Confirm Your Article Outline
step4.description: After you confirm the title, Nexaura AI analyzes the content structures of the top 10 Google results for your keyword, it then generates the optimal article outline for you.

step5.title: Maximum visibility in Google and AI Chats
step5.description: Nexaura AI will gather expert opinions, user reviews and authoritative data. It will then integrate these high-quality materials into the article and optimize it based on Google's E-E-A-T algorithm.
